security_rules.name: Aadhaar Masking
security_rules.description: Masks 12-digit Indian Aadhaar numbers to show only the last 4 digits (e.g. XXXX XXXX 9012).

security_rules.name: PAN Masking
security_rules.description: Masks 10-character Indian Permanent Account Numbers (e.g. XXXXX1234F).

security_rules.name: Email Masking
security_rules.description: Masks personal and corporate email addresses (e.g. r***@example.com).

security_rules.name: Phone Masking
security_rules.description: Masks primary digits of mobile and telephone numbers (e.g. ******3210).

security_rules.name: Bank Account Masking
security_rules.description: Masks account numbers in bank statements and payment records.

security_rules.name: Credit Card Masking
security_rules.description: PCI-DSS compliant masking of credit and debit card numbers (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234).
